objective: Rank human A2A ligands by measured potency while quantifying applicability and testing whether dual-state docking adds information beyond two-dimensional chemistry.

historical_boundary.development_use: Current ChEMBL-derived potency results may be reproduced and used for exploratory model development only.

primary_pbind.name: pBind_Ki
primary_pbind.meaning: negative base-10 logarithm of molar human A2A Ki

secondary_pfunc_agonism.name: pFunc_agonism
secondary_pfunc_agonism.meaning: negative base-10 logarithm of molar agonist EC50 or explicitly named functional potency

secondary_pfunc_inhibition.name: pFunc_inhibition
secondary_pfunc_inhibition.meaning: negative base-10 logarithm of molar antagonist IC50 in an agonist-stimulated human A2A functional assay

prohibited_pooling: Ki with Kd, IC50, EC50, or generic pChEMBL in the primary endpoint
antagonist inhibition of stimulated response with inverse agonist inhibition of basal activity

measurement_admission.pactivity_rule: Use ChEMBL pchembl_value only when it is consistent with -log10(standard_value in molar units); otherwise quarantine the row.
exclude_if: mutant receptor unless prospectively declared as a separate task
binding or functional mode cannot be determined
activity value is copied only from a review
critical structure or stereochemistry is unresolved

replicate_aggregation.level_1: Take the median of exact duplicate measurements within one assay after provenance checks.
replicate_aggregation.level_2: Take the median of assay-level values within the same endpoint and functional mode for each standardized parent structure.
replicate_aggregation.high_disagreement_rule: Do not silently delete high-variance molecules. Flag inter-assay SD above 0.75 log units and report sensitivity with and without them.
replicate_aggregation.sample_weighting: Primary analysis gives one equal-weighted row per molecule. Inverse-variance weighting is sensitivity-only.

development_evaluation.sparse_fold_rule: When a test fold has fewer than 10 records, report MAE and RMSE but mark fold-level R2 unevaluable.

qsar_primary.name: AB_RF
qsar_primary.features: ECFP4 radius 2, 2048 bits, plus the frozen physicochemical descriptor panel

docking_augmented.name: E_RF
docking_augmented.missing_docking_rule: Do not impute from the outcome. Report a matched-record comparison and a chemistry-only prediction for unmatched records.

applicability_domain.chemistry_similarity: maximum ECFP4 Tanimoto similarity to a training molecule
applicability_domain.descriptor_distance: robust distance in the frozen physicochemical descriptor space
applicability_domain.threshold_freeze: Derive the similarity threshold from the fifth percentile of held-out-to-training nearest-neighbor similarities across the fixed development scaffold folds; derive the descriptor threshold from the training 99th percentile. Freeze both before external outcomes are joined.
applicability_domain.outside_domain_action: Return a prediction with an explicit abstention or high-uncertainty flag.
applicability_domain.reason: Docking has its own applicability limits and cannot automatically replace an uncertain QSAR prediction.

mandatory_metrics: metrics stratified by endpoint and functional mode

uncertainty.development: molecule-level bootstrap of fixed out-of-fold predictions with 2000 resamples

external_confirmation.final_sample_size_rule: Treat 60 molecules and 20 scaffolds as planning floors. Before outcomes are unmasked, freeze a simulation or precision analysis for the desired external R2 and paired delta-R2 confidence interval.
external_confirmation.primary_success: External R2 bootstrap lower bound is above zero and RMSE is lower than the training-mean baseline with a paired 95% interval excluding zero.
external_confirmation.docking_increment: Compare E_RF minus AB_RF on identical external molecules using delta R2 and delta RMSE. Claim incremental value only when the delta-R2 lower bound is above zero and the delta-RMSE upper bound is below zero.

allowed: extract candidate measurement passages and table locations
prohibited: invent or infer missing activity values
convert docking or model predictions into labels
admit a measurement without deterministic provenance checks
llm_role.required_release_gate: deterministic validation plus named human approval

requirements: all source, split, model, and prediction hashes verify
applicability and calibration results are acceptable
